_comment: Regression gate for the 'Presidio + pack' system, enforced by
check_thresholds.py in CI. Identifier entities are deterministic
(regex + checksum on a fixed-seed corpus) and must stay at 1.0.
PERSON/DATE/ADDRESS depend on the spaCy NLP engine and get floors
slightly below current measured values to absorb model-version drift.
Applies to both gold and generated splits.
_min_span_precision_comment: Re-pinned 0.78 -> 0.75 after 3.3 CA benchmark diversity (measured ca 0.761-0.770, in 0.795-0.799). The drop is spaCy built-in noise on richer templates (ORGANIZATION on hospital headers, DATE_TIME on durations); pack entities contribute zero benchmark FPs — pack precision is gated separately by negatives_max_fp_per_100_notes.

hard_min_recall._comment: Regression floors for 'Presidio + pack' per-variant leak recall on the CA adversarial split (results/hard_ca.json). These are NOT targets: measured 2026-07-03 control 1.00, no_context 0.96, unusual_separator 0.56, line_wrap 0.38, ocr_confusable 0.38, dictation 0.50. Floors sit below measured to absorb seed/model drift; low values are honest findings, and raising them requires actual robustness work, not corpus tweaks.

address_min_strict_recall._comment: Strict recall on the ODA holdout address corpus (results/address_ca.json). Measured 2026-07-03: pack 0.950; main-benchmark CA gold ADDRESS strict 0.971 after CA_STREET_ADDRESS recognizer.

negatives_max_fp_per_100_notes._comment: FP ceiling on the PII-free confusables corpus (results/negatives_ca.json). Residual FPs are irreducible checksum collisions on random digit strings (~8% of random 9-digit strings pass SIN, ~10% of random 10-digit strings pass OHIP).
